title: From Uncertain Judgments to Calibrated Rankings: Conformal Elo Estimation for LLM Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2606.13221v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Evaluating new large language models typically requires costly human annotation campaigns at scale. LLM-as-a-judge offers a cheaper alternative, but judge scores carry systematic errors -- such as position bias, self-preference, or intransitivity -- that can strongly miscalibrate the resulting rankings. We quantify the resulting judge-human disagreement at two complementary levels. At the local level, we estimate per-battle uncertainty from the judge's own score differences by propagating calibrated win probabilities rather than hard labels into the Bradley-Terry procedure. translated_title: 从不确定的判断到经过校准的排名：用于大语言模型评估的保形Elo估计
translated_abstract: 评估新的大型语言模型通常需要大规模且成本高昂的人工标注工作。LLM-as-a-judge（以大模型作为评判者）提供了一种更廉价的替代方案，但评判模型自身的评分存在系统性误差——例如位置偏差、自我偏好或不可传递性——这些误差会严重破坏由此产生的排名的校准性。我们在两个互补的层面对这种评判与人类之间的分歧进行了量化。在局部层面，我们通过将校准后的获胜概率（而非硬标签）传播到Bradley-Terry程序中，从评判模型自身的评分差异中估计每场对战的胜负不确定性。仅这一方法就大幅提升了Elo估计的准确性，在LMArena上对55个留出模型取平均时，使基于大模型得出的评分与基于人类得出的评分之间的Elo平均绝对误差缩小至17.9以内。在全局层面，我们对留出模型上基于大模型得出的Elo评分与基于人类得出的Elo评分之间的残差差距应用了分割保形预测，从而生成预测区间（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出保形Elo估计方法，通过将校准后的获胜概率而非硬标签传入Bradley-Terry过程来量化每场对战的胜负不确定性，并对人机Elo评分的残差差距应用分割保形预测，使LLM-as-a-judge得出的模型排名与人类评分仅相差17.9 Elo平均绝对误差，同时提供具有统计保证的预测区间。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Conformal Elo estimation for LLM evaluation, which propagates calibrated win probabilities (instead of hard labels) into the Bradley-Terry procedure to quantify per-battle uncertainty and applies split conformal prediction to the residual gap between LLM-derived and human-derived ratings, achieving rankings within 17.9 Elo MAE of human judgments while providing statistically guaranteed prediction intervals.
